english.SC_Bearing_Desc: Lets the block on its top face spin around the bearing's axis. A Drive Shaft from a Motor turns it; a data signal holds an angle instead. The arrows on the side show which way a positive signal turns the top.

english.SC_GyroBearing_Desc: Keeps whatever is on top of it level against gravity, by itself. A data signal shifts the levelled angle. Two stacked at 90 degrees make a gimbal for a camera, antenna or platform.

english.SC_Volante_Desc: Steering wheel: turn it with the mouse and it sends -1 to 1 out of the port under its base. Glue the base to the wall behind it.
english.SC_Pedal_Desc: Two pedals on one block: step on the right one for 1, the left one for -1, and the port adds the two.
english.SC_Beacon_Port0: Power input: 5 P/s while transmitting. Without power the beacon does not show on the radars.
english.SC_Beacon M_Port0: Power input: 5 P/s while transmitting. Without power the beacon does not show on the radars.
english.SC_TurretSeat_Desc: Seat that aims with the mouse: the base stays glued to the ship and everything glued to the 4 support plates turns with your view. Ctrl shows the cursor.
english.SC_DriveShaft_Desc: The mod's own cable: carries a Motor's force to the Bearings. It does not carry data or power.
english.SC_Differential_Desc: Splits one Drive Shaft into 4, sharing the motor's force among them.
english.SC_ShaftReverser_Desc: Reverse gear: flips the direction of the Drive Shaft that goes through it.
english.SC_ShaftReverser_Port1: Drive Shaft output, turning the other way.
english.SC_Differential M_Desc: Splits one Drive Shaft into 4, sharing the motor's force among them.
english.SC_ShaftReverser M_Desc: Reverse gear: flips the direction of the Drive Shaft that goes through it.
english.SC_ShaftReverser M_Port1: Drive Shaft output, turning the other way.
english.SC_ShaftTransmitter_Desc: Sends a Motor's force wirelessly: the shaft that goes into one comes out of every other Shaft Transmitter on the same channel. Good for steering knuckles and suspensions.
english.SC_ShaftTransmitter_Port0: Drive Shaft in or out (input on the motor's side, output on the other side).

english.SC_SingleCellBattery_Desc: One cell of the small rechargeable battery: 2x4x2, stores 500 P (a quarter of the small battery). Charges and discharges like the game's batteries.
english.SC_MiniElectricThruster_Desc: The small electric thruster at half size (0.5 x 1 x 0.5): a quarter of the force and of the power use. Same glow, flame and reverse button.
english.SC_MiniElectricThruster M_Desc: The small electric thruster at half size (0.5 x 1 x 0.5): a quarter of the force and of the power use. Same glow, flame and reverse button.
english.SC_LongRangeTransmitter_Desc: Wireless data with no distance limit, to any vehicle in the world. The channel comes from a data input and can change during the simulation. Carries camera video too.
english.SC_SolarPanelMini_Desc: The solar panel at the size of a Frame Quarter (0.5 x 0.125 x 0.5): an eighth of the area and of the power it makes. Charges batteries like the big one.

portuguese.SC_Bearing_Desc: Deixa o bloco da face de cima girar em volta do eixo do bearing. Um Drive Shaft de um Motor faz ele girar; um sinal de dados segura um ângulo. As setinhas mostram pra que lado o sinal positivo gira.

portuguese.SC_TurretSeat_Desc: Banco que mira com o mouse: a base fica colada na nave e tudo que estiver colado nas 4 placas gira com a sua visão. Ctrl mostra o cursor.
portuguese.SC_DriveShaft_Desc: O cabo próprio do mod: leva a força de um Motor até os Bearings. Não leva dados nem energia.
portuguese.SC_Differential_Desc: Divide um Drive Shaft em 4, repartindo a força do motor entre eles.
portuguese.SC_ShaftReverser_Desc: Marcha ré: inverte o sentido do Drive Shaft que passa por ele.

portuguese.SC_SingleCellBattery_Desc: Uma célula da bateria recarregável pequena: 2x4x2, guarda 500 P (um quarto da pequena). Carrega e descarrega igual às baterias do jogo.
portuguese.SC_MiniElectricThruster_Desc: O propulsor elétrico pequeno em metade do tamanho (0,5 x 1 x 0,5): um quarto da força e do consumo. Mesmo brilho, chama e botão de ré.

portuguese.SC_LongRangeTransmitter_Name: Long Range Transmitter (transmissor de longo alcance)
portuguese.SC_LongRangeTransmitter_Desc: Dados sem fio, sem limite de distância, pra qualquer veículo do mundo. O canal vem de uma entrada de dados e pode mudar durante a simulação. Leva vídeo de câmera também.
portuguese.SC_SolarPanelMini_Desc: O painel solar do tamanho de um Frame Quarter (0,5 x 0,125 x 0,5): um oitavo da área e da energia gerada. Carrega baterias igual ao grande.

portuguese.SC_Pistao_Desc: Empurra o bloco da face de cima ao longo do eixo, proporcional ao sinal. Um bloco PISTON END no eixo define o curso exato, e a haste já nasce esticada na garagem.
